scope.note: This audit predicts the sourceAction branch by reading source and static attributes. It does not claim observed product output or live site behavior. No evaluation metric is changed.

contractEvidence.quote: 일반 링크는 바로 이동한다는 사용자 선택
contractEvidence.meaning: Plain HTTP links are direct navigation; property/delegated handlers are a documented uncertainty.
Only local/same-document fragment links receive the fragment locate exception; role button and aria-controls/haspopup independently locate.
Explicit marker rule precedes URL navigation.

contractEvidence.quote: url.origin === location.origin && url.pathname === location.pathname && url.search === location.search && !!url.hash
contractEvidence.meaning: A cross-document fragment fails localFragment, then ordinary reserved/empty target permits navigate.

contractEvidence.quote: SSO 식별 목록과 파일 확장자 목록은 완전하지 않다.
contractEvidence.meaning: Authentication wording and limited SSO recognition must be distinguished; plain login-form destinations are not resolved by simply equating category login with locate.

findings.reason: The explicit control markers require locate despite the public HTTP destination. The observation independently records role=button; ARIA attributes are additionally visible in the frozen fixture. This is not evidence of a product defect.
findings.proposedPostHoldoutOnlyCorrection: In a separate adjudicated development revision, change this accepted action to locate with rationale. Preserve original v7/v2, freezes and first raw evaluation.

evidenceQuotes: site note: "HTTP 경로의 fragment가 있으므로 모두 locate이다."
findings.reason: Each destination has a different pathname. The note applies an any-fragment rule that the action contract does not define. Empty target explicitly means _self. No recorded explicit control marker changes these to locate. Mere appearance as tabs does not establish handler behavior.
findings.proposedPostHoldoutOnlyCorrection: Separately version the five accepted actions, three expected actions and the SMU task action/instruction to match cross-document direct navigation; retain smu-second as locate in the real source document. No raw metric should be overwritten.

evidenceQuotes: src/action-policy.ts only recognizes sso|oauth2?|saml|authorize pathname markers
docs/ACTION_POLICY.md includes "인증 등 locate 제어" and admits incomplete SSO recognition
findings.reason: The accepted locate annotations appear to encode semantic login safety, while sourceAction has no category argument and these plain login-form URLs match no authentication path marker. Static evidence does not prove that opening the form starts authentication, nor prove absence of delegated/property handlers. Thus this is a policy coverage/annotation-contract ambiguity, not a proven site-behavior defect or an unconditional annotation error.
findings.proposedPostHoldoutOnlyCorrection: Explicitly decide whether public login-form-page navigation is permitted direct navigation. If permitted, document that and separately adjudicate these accepted actions to navigate. If login entry itself must always locate, keep the annotation but record and address authentication-recognition coverage as a product limitation. Do not invent onclick or other markers to force the fixture result.

findings.reason: smu-second is genuinely a same-document fragment on the observed source. The parity observation used about:blank for the fixture, so preservation of absolute href/destination alone does not preserve localFragment semantics. This audit did not inspect or execute the evaluator and cannot establish its context.
findings.proposedPostHoldoutOnlyCorrection: Audit evaluator document URL context separately before attributing any same-document-fragment mismatch to the engine. Do not change the smu-second source-context action solely because of an about:blank fixture observation.
